// SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
// Test data: Copyright Grafana Labs contributors.
// Adapted for Pulse on 2026-10-28; the adjacent LICENSE applies.
// This standard-library-only AST/source extractor never runs Loki or Pulse.
// From the repository root, with the two unmodified pinned source files:
//
//	cp test/fixtures/logs/loki-upstream/logfmt-producer.go.txt /tmp/logfmt-producer.go
//	go build -o /tmp/logfmt-producer /tmp/logfmt-producer.go
//	/tmp/logfmt-producer parser_test.go parsers.logqltest > /tmp/logfmt.json
//	cmp /tmp/logfmt.json test/fixtures/logs/loki-upstream/logfmt.json
//
// Normal Elixir replay reads the committed JSON, without Go or network access.
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

const revision = "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d"
const parserPath = "pkg/logql/log/parser_test.go"
const enginePath = "pkg/logql/internal/logqltest/testdata/parsers.logqltest"

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func require(ok bool, message string) {
	if !ok {
		panic(message)
	}
}

func hash(data []byte) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(data)) }
func number(s string) int     { n, err := strconv.Atoi(s); must(err); return n }
func unquote(s string) string { v, err := strconv.Unquote(s); must(err); return v }
func literal(e ast.Expr) string {
	lit, ok := e.(*ast.BasicLit)
	require(ok && lit.Kind == token.STRING, "expected string literal")
	return unquote(lit.Value)
}

type selection struct {
	Purpose     string `json:"purpose"`
	SourceStart int    `json:"source_start"`
	SourceEnd   int    `json:"source_end"`
	SHA256      string `json:"sha256"`
	Raw         string `json:"raw"`
}

type source struct {
	Path       string      `json:"path"`
	SHA256     string      `json:"sha256"`
	URL        string      `json:"url"`
	Selections []selection `json:"selections"`
}

func selectLines(data []byte, first, last int, purpose string) selection {
	lines := strings.SplitAfter(string(data), "\n")
	require(first > 0 && last >= first && last <= len(lines), "invalid source range")
	raw := strings.Join(lines[first-1:last], "")
	return selection{purpose, first, last, hash([]byte(raw)), raw}
}

func loadSource(path, upstream, expectedHash string) ([]byte, source) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	must(err)
	require(hash(data) == expectedHash, "unrecognized source bytes: "+upstream)
	return data, source{Path: upstream, SHA256: hash(data), URL: "https://github.com/grafana/loki/blob/" + revision + "/" + upstream}
}

type tableCase struct {
	Name                string            `json:"name"`
	Line                *string           `json:"line"`
	LineExpression      string            `json:"line_expression"`
	BaseLabels          map[string]string `json:"base_labels"`
	Want                map[string]string `json:"want"`
	WantStrict          map[string]string `json:"want_strict"`
	EffectiveStrictWant map[string]string `json:"effective_strict_want"`
	HintExpression      string            `json:"hint_expression"`
	StructuredMetadata  map[string]string `json:"structured_metadata"`
	KeepEmpty           bool              `json:"keep_empty"`
	SourceStart         int               `json:"source_start"`
	SourceEnd           int               `json:"source_end"`
}

func labels(e ast.Expr) map[string]string {
	call := e.(*ast.CallExpr)
	selector := call.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
	require(selector.X.(*ast.Ident).Name == "labels", "unexpected labels package")
	out := map[string]string{}
	if selector.Sel.Name == "EmptyLabels" {
		require(len(call.Args) == 0, "unexpected EmptyLabels arguments")
		return out
	}
	require(selector.Sel.Name == "FromStrings" && len(call.Args)%2 == 0, "unsupported labels expression")
	for i := 0; i < len(call.Args); i += 2 {
		key := literal(call.Args[i])
		_, exists := out[key]
		require(!exists, "duplicate expected label")
		out[key] = literal(call.Args[i+1])
	}
	return out
}

func extractTables(data []byte) ([]tableCase, []tableCase) {
	fset := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fset, parserPath, data, 0)
	must(err)
	raw := func(n ast.Node) string {
		return string(data[fset.Position(n.Pos()).Offset:fset.Position(n.End()).Offset])
	}
	var parseCases, emptyCases []tableCase
	for _, decl := range f.Decls {
		fn, ok := decl.(*ast.FuncDecl)
		if !ok || (fn.Name.Name != "TestLogfmtParser_parse" && fn.Name.Name != "TestLogfmtParser_keepEmpty") {
			continue
		}
		assign := fn.Body.List[0].(*ast.AssignStmt)
		require(assign.Lhs[0].(*ast.Ident).Name == "tests", "expected tests table")
		table := assign.Rhs[0].(*ast.CompositeLit)
		isParse := fn.Name.Name == "TestLogfmtParser_parse"
		require((isParse && len(table.Elts) == 20) || (!isParse && len(table.Elts) == 4), "unexpected table size")
		for index, e := range table.Elts {
			item := e.(*ast.CompositeLit)
			name := literal(item.Elts[0])
			if isParse && index == 19 {
				require(name == "duplicate conflict with structured metadata" && fset.Position(item.Pos()).Line == 1418 && fset.Position(item.End()).Line == 1429, "unexpected omitted row")
				continue
			}
			row := tableCase{Name: name, LineExpression: raw(item.Elts[1]), StructuredMetadata: map[string]string{},
				SourceStart: fset.Position(item.Pos()).Line, SourceEnd: fset.Position(item.End()).Line}
			if ident, ok := item.Elts[1].(*ast.Ident); ok {
				require(ident.Name == "nil", "unexpected line identifier")
			} else {
				call := item.Elts[1].(*ast.CallExpr)
				require(raw(call.Fun) == "[]byte" && len(call.Args) == 1, "unexpected line conversion")
				line := literal(call.Args[0])
				row.Line = &line
			}
			if isParse {
				require(len(item.Elts) == 7 && raw(item.Elts[6]) == "nil", "unexpected parse row shape/metadata")
				row.BaseLabels, row.Want, row.WantStrict = labels(item.Elts[2]), labels(item.Elts[3]), labels(item.Elts[4])
				row.HintExpression = raw(item.Elts[5])
			} else {
				require(len(item.Elts) == 5, "unexpected keep-empty row shape")
				flag := item.Elts[2].(*ast.Ident).Name
				require(flag == "true" || flag == "false", "unexpected keep-empty flag")
				row.KeepEmpty = flag == "true"
				row.BaseLabels, row.Want = labels(item.Elts[3]), labels(item.Elts[4])
				row.WantStrict = map[string]string{}
				row.HintExpression = "nil" // The keepEmpty harness supplies nil, not a table column.
			}
			row.EffectiveStrictWant = row.Want
			if len(row.WantStrict) != 0 {
				row.EffectiveStrictWant = row.WantStrict
			}
			if isParse {
				parseCases = append(parseCases, row)
			} else {
				emptyCases = append(emptyCases, row)
			}
		}
	}
	require(len(parseCases) == 19 && parseCases[18].Name == "= in value" && len(emptyCases) == 4, "incorrect table selection")
	return parseCases, emptyCases
}

type load struct {
	Labels      map[string]string `json:"labels"`
	Line        string            `json:"line"`
	Start       int               `json:"start"`
	Every       int               `json:"every"`
	Count       int               `json:"count"`
	Metadata    map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
	SourceStart int               `json:"source_start"`
	Raw         string            `json:"raw"`
}
type series struct {
	Labels map[string]string `json:"labels"`
	Values []string          `json:"values"`
}
type engineCase struct {
	Query       string   `json:"query"`
	Instant     bool     `json:"instant"`
	Start       int      `json:"start"`
	End         int      `json:"end"`
	Step        int      `json:"step"`
	Expected    []series `json:"expected"`
	Outcome     string   `json:"outcome"`
	Reject      string   `json:"reject,omitempty"`
	SourceStart int      `json:"source_start"`
	SourceEnd   int      `json:"source_end"`
	Raw         string   `json:"raw"`
}
type fixture struct {
	SourceStart int          `json:"source_start"`
	SourceEnd   int          `json:"source_end"`
	Loads       []load       `json:"loads"`
	Cases       []engineCase `json:"cases"`
}

var goString = "(?:\"(?:[^\"\\\\]|\\\\.)*\"|`[^`]*`)"
var labelPair = regexp.MustCompile(`^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(` + goString + `)`)

func labelText(text string) map[string]string {
	out := map[string]string{}
	for text = strings.TrimSpace(text); text != ""; text = strings.TrimSpace(text) {
		m := labelPair.FindStringSubmatch(text)
		require(m != nil, "unexpected label text: "+text)
		_, exists := out[m[1]]
		require(!exists, "duplicate label text")
		out[m[1]] = unquote(m[2])
		text = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(text[len(m[0]):], ","))
	}
	return out
}

func extractEngine(data []byte) []fixture {
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	loadRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^\{([^}]*)\}\s+(` + goString + `) @ (\d+)s(?: \[repeat every (\d+)s for (\d+)\])?(?: \[metadata (.*)\])?$`)
	instantRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^eval instant at (\d+)s (.+)$`)
	rangeRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^eval range from (\d+)s to (\d+)s step (\d+)s (.+)$`)
	resultRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^\{([^}]*)\}\s+([\d_ ]+)$`)
	var fixtures []fixture
	var current *fixture
	var evaluation *engineCase
	finishCase := func() {
		if evaluation != nil {
			require((evaluation.Outcome == "series" && len(evaluation.Expected) > 0) || (evaluation.Outcome != "series" && len(evaluation.Expected) == 0), "missing or contradictory expectation")
			evaluation.Raw = strings.Join(lines[evaluation.SourceStart-1:evaluation.SourceEnd], "\n") + "\n"
			current.Cases = append(current.Cases, *evaluation)
			current.SourceEnd = evaluation.SourceEnd
			evaluation = nil
		}
	}
	finishFixture := func() {
		finishCase()
		if current != nil {
			require(len(current.Loads) == 2 && len(current.Cases) > 0, "incomplete fixture")
			fixtures = append(fixtures, *current)
			current = nil
		}
	}
	// Deliberately bounded, not a general logqltest parser. Gaps cannot inherit loads.
	for _, bounds := range [][2]int{{1, 33}, {84, 114}} {
		for lineNo := bounds[0]; lineNo <= bounds[1]; lineNo++ {
			text := strings.TrimSpace(lines[lineNo-1])
			if text == "" || strings.HasPrefix(text, "#") {
				continue
			}
			switch {
			case text == "clear":
				finishFixture()
				current = &fixture{SourceStart: lineNo}
			case text == "load":
				require(current != nil && len(current.Loads) == 0, "unexpected load directive")
			case strings.HasPrefix(text, "eval "):
				finishCase()
				require(current != nil && len(current.Loads) > 0, "evaluation without loads")
				evaluation = &engineCase{SourceStart: lineNo, SourceEnd: lineNo, Expected: []series{}, Outcome: "series"}
				text = strings.Split(text, " #")[0]
				if m := instantRE.FindStringSubmatch(strings.TrimSpace(text)); m != nil {
					evaluation.Instant, evaluation.Start, evaluation.End, evaluation.Query = true, number(m[1]), number(m[1]), m[2]
				} else if m := rangeRE.FindStringSubmatch(strings.TrimSpace(text)); m != nil {
					evaluation.Start, evaluation.End, evaluation.Step, evaluation.Query = number(m[1]), number(m[2]), number(m[3]), m[4]
				} else {
					panic("unexpected evaluation: " + text)
				}
			case evaluation != nil:
				require(evaluation.Outcome == "series", "expectation after terminal outcome")
				evaluation.SourceEnd = lineNo
				if text == "expect empty" {
					evaluation.Outcome = "empty"
				} else if strings.HasPrefix(text, "expect fail msg: ") {
					evaluation.Outcome, evaluation.Reject = "reject", strings.TrimPrefix(text, "expect fail msg: ")
				} else {
					m := resultRE.FindStringSubmatch(text)
					require(m != nil, "unexpected expected series: "+text)
					evaluation.Expected = append(evaluation.Expected, series{labelText(m[1]), strings.Fields(m[2])})
				}
			default:
				require(current != nil, "load without clear")
				m := loadRE.FindStringSubmatch(text)
				require(m != nil, "unexpected load: "+text)
				row := load{Labels: labelText(m[1]), Line: unquote(m[2]), Start: number(m[3]), Count: 1, Metadata: labelText(m[6]), SourceStart: lineNo, Raw: lines[lineNo-1] + "\n"}
				if m[4] != "" {
					row.Every, row.Count = number(m[4]), number(m[5])
				}
				current.Loads = append(current.Loads, row)
			}
		}
		finishFixture()
	}
	require(len(fixtures) == 4, "incorrect engine fixture count")
	return fixtures
}

func main() {
	require(len(os.Args) == 3, "usage: logfmt-producer parser_test.go parsers.logqltest")
	parserData, parserSource := loadSource(os.Args[1], parserPath, "346b91ced2d38e51d8cf7fd8acb3335ea5796e9286fd901b45dd625c0b3634ff")
	engineData, engineSource := loadSource(os.Args[2], enginePath, "07d63941842085ca40bbc3944884377e802df38ede67027b9702594e840114ea")
	parserSource.Selections = []selection{
		selectLines(parserData, 1191, 1417, "first 19 TestLogfmtParser_parse table rows"),
		selectLines(parserData, 1478, 1511, "all four TestLogfmtParser_keepEmpty table rows"),
	}
	engineSource.Selections = []selection{
		selectLines(engineData, 1, 33, "complete basic and lexical edge-case fixtures"),
		selectLines(engineData, 84, 114, "complete malformed/strict and label-expression fixtures"),
	}
	parseCases, emptyCases := extractTables(parserData)
	fixtures := extractEngine(engineData)
	counts := map[string]int{"parse_rows": len(parseCases), "keep_empty_rows": len(emptyCases), "table_evaluations": 2 * (len(parseCases) + len(emptyCases)), "engine_fixtures": len(fixtures)}
	for _, fixture := range fixtures {
		counts["engine_load_rows"] += len(fixture.Loads)
		for _, load := range fixture.Loads {
			counts["engine_loaded_entries"] += load.Count
		}
		for _, row := range fixture.Cases {
			counts["engine_evaluations"]++
			if row.Instant {
				counts["engine_instant_evaluations"]++
			} else {
				counts["engine_range_evaluations"]++
			}
			counts["engine_"+row.Outcome+"_evaluations"]++
			counts["engine_expected_series"] += len(row.Expected)
			for _, series := range row.Expected {
				for _, value := range series.Values {
					if value == "_" {
						counts["engine_sparse_slots"]++
					} else {
						counts["engine_numeric_slots"]++
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	counts["total_evaluations"] = counts["table_evaluations"] + counts["engine_evaluations"]
	require(counts["engine_evaluations"] == 14 && counts["engine_instant_evaluations"] == 8 && counts["engine_range_evaluations"] == 6 && counts["engine_reject_evaluations"] == 2 && counts["engine_empty_evaluations"] == 1 && counts["engine_series_evaluations"] == 11, "incorrect evaluation selection")
	require(counts["engine_load_rows"] == 8 && counts["engine_loaded_entries"] == 28 && counts["engine_numeric_slots"] == 17 && counts["engine_sparse_slots"] == 2 && counts["total_evaluations"] == 60, "incorrect geometry/counts")
	artifact := map[string]any{
		"schema_version": 1,
		"revision":       revision,
		"license":        "AGPL-3.0-only",
		"attribution":    "Grafana Labs contributors; extraction adapted for Pulse on 2026-10-28. See adjacent LICENSE. No upstream runtime implementation is included.",
		"provenance":     map[string]any{"repository": "https://github.com/grafana/loki", "producer": "test/fixtures/logs/loki-upstream/logfmt-producer.go.txt", "sources": []source{parserSource, engineSource}, "range_hash_convention": "SHA-256 of exact inclusive complete source lines, including the final newline; raw selections preserve comments, indentation and spelling."},
		"replay": map[string]any{
			"strict_values":      []bool{false, true},
			"table_expectations": "For parse_cases, strict=false uses want; strict=true uses effective_strict_want (nonempty wantStrict, otherwise want), matching parser_test.go:1460-1464. For keep_empty_cases, both modes use want, matching parser_test.go:1514-1534; want_strict={} is a schema placeholder, not an upstream column.",
			"hints":              "hint_expression is inert original Go text, never evaluated. Replay extracts all fields rather than implementing Loki ParserHint optimizations; the one NewParserHint row requests __error__. keep_empty_cases has no hint column: nil is the actual harness argument at parser_test.go:1523.",
			"nil_line":           "A null line preserves upstream nil; adapt to an empty binary for lexical replay, without changing the frozen line_expression.",
			"engine":             "All times/steps/repeat intervals are seconds; count preserves the repeat-for count (total entries). Keep load order, noise and metadata. instant has equal start/end and step=0. Expected values are original numeric strings or sparse underscores. outcome distinguishes series, explicit empty and rejection; reject is the original expected message substring, not a full response envelope.",
			"requirements":       "Normal Elixir replay needs only this committed JSON, no Go, network or Loki/Pulse runtime to generate expectations.",
		},
		"omissions": []any{
			map[string]any{"source": parserPath, "source_start": 1418, "source_end": 1429, "name": "duplicate conflict with structured metadata", "reason": "Explicitly excluded: stream/structured-metadata/parser collision ownership remains a known gap and is not changed in this batch. Existing stream-collision rows in the requested first 19 and all four keep-empty rows remain exact, not rewritten."},
			map[string]any{"source": enginePath, "source_start": 34, "source_end": 83, "reason": "Outside requested selections: collision ownership, drop/re-added labels and _extracted collision fixtures are deliberately not claimed."},
			"All other upstream unit functions/table rows and engine ranges are outside this bounded extraction. This artifact is not complete Loki parser, hint, collision-ownership, client, deployment or capacity conformance proof.",
		},
		"counts":           counts,
		"parse_cases":      parseCases,
		"keep_empty_cases": emptyCases,
		"fixtures":         fixtures,
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	must(enc.Encode(artifact))
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "19 parse rows + 4 keep-empty rows x 2 strict modes = 46 table evaluations; 4 engine fixtures / 14 evaluations; 60 total\n")
}
